title: Cost-Effective and Functional Alternatives to Thermanox Cover Rings for Tumor Xenotransplantation on Fertilized Chicken Eggs
protocol: Enlarge the ring hole to a diameter of approximately 9 mm with scissors.
Store washed Thermanox rings in a sterile petri dish.
Pour an agar gel of about 2 mm high and allow it to solidify.
Cut out platelets from the agar gel using the open end of 15 ml Falcon tubes.
Prepare agar rings by cutting out the inlet with FACS tubes.
Store prepared agar rings in sterile PBS at 4°C.
Cut PVC tube rings from PVC tubes using sterile scissors.
Wash PVC tube rings with 70% ethanol.
Store washed PVC tube rings in a sterile petri dish.
Place each ring type on 10 chicken eggs.
Seed 1×10^6 AsanPaCa cells in 25 µl Matrigel into each ring.
Euthanize chick embryos at day 18 of development.
Resect tumor xenografts from the chick embryos.
